title: Malena S NDE 5418
content: One night I woke up with an intense pain in my chest and great difficulty breathing. The pain was so intense and so sharp that I surrendered and I 'went'. Here, I lost consciousness as I passed into a state of relief where I was no longer in pain. The last time I looked at the clock, it had been 4 am and when I revived, or at least when I regained consciousness, the clock in front of me said 7 am. However, there were critical seconds during which my heart had stopped. During the drama of the doctors were assisting me, I felt that I was already in another place totally outside of my body. I remember being floating over my body while I was going into a tunnel. It was dark. Further into the tunnel, I lost all perception of my body. Now it was as if I was in an ocean of stillness, of calm, of silence, of rest. I was happy, so happy, and I had an indescribable peace. I was in a state of extreme joy when suddenly I hear a very strong VOICE, powerful and omnipotent, that told me that I had to go back. I did not want to go back, but this VOICE was so powerful that it was impossible not to obey the order, 'You must return to life. You still have three missions to complete.' I began to feel that, from a stillness in which I found myself, I was now traveling quickly; I was 'returning' to life. Then, I manage to ask, 'What missions do I have?', and it answered me question by question. Then I return to life, and the pain that was just as bad, and the physical drama. When I felt them slapping me lightly on the face, I opened my eyes, and saw a lot of doctors and nurses surrounding my bed. There were lights, noise, voices, hustle and bustle, PAIN, anxiety, drama, etc. I stayed eight days in intensive care, but they were eight wonderful days for my soul, because I had been with GOD. For a few moments, I had been floating from my physical body and passing to that place that didn't have space, and there I felt the Presence of God, which filled me with an immense peace. My physical state was very delicate; I had been on the border of heart surgery, but 'something miraculous happened', and the clot began to reabsorb itself; there was no longer a necessity for surgery. After eight days, I left intensive care, and they gave me a break from oxygen. During the following thirty days, I continued to have paranormal experiences in which I visited past lives, saw myself in other times, in other ages and in other countries, and with some members of my family, who were older or younger and who fulfilled other roles. When I left this state and returned HERE, then I understood more about my life, about my relatives, and why I was having that experience. It took a year to be able to relate this to my parents because I couldn't find words to describe it. It took five years to be able to understand what the second mission was about, and it took ten years to be able to understand the third mission that I had to fulfill. Now that sixteen years have passed since this experience, I feel that I have more understanding about what happened. I am explaining the three missions that I've come to complete, that which makes me very happy and makes me feel ready to be able to narrate it and share it with everyone else.

arrival.other_being_detail: Heard a very strong, powerful voice described as omnipotent; later described being with GOD and feeling the Presence of God.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as a dark tunnel, then "an ocean of stillness, of calm, of silence, of rest" and "that place that didn't have space."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: "You must return to life. You still have three missions to complete." She asked what missions she had and the voice answered "question by question" (missions not specified in the narrative).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Woke with intense chest pain and difficulty breathing; later mentions a clot and being near heart surgery; heart stopped briefly.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Post-NDE: "paranormal experiences" including visiting past lives.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (floating over body) while going into a dark tunnel; then loss of body perception and stillness/peace; then a powerful voice orders return with missions; rapid return to body and resuscitation scene.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After returning, for ~30 days reported paranormal experiences of visiting past lives and seeing family members in other roles/ages.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "You must return to life. You still have three missions to complete."; "an ocean of stillness, of calm, of silence, of rest."; "that place that didn't have space."
